final: WITH mt AS (SELECT m.Name AS name, AVG(t.Bytes * 1.0 / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_bpm FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 AND t.Milliseconds > 0 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bpm) AS oa FROM mt) SELECT mt.name, mt.avg_bpm, mt.avg_bpm - overall.oa AS above_by FROM mt, overall WHERE mt.avg_bpm > overall.oa ORDER BY mt.avg_bpm DESC
